rules.title: Forbidding the Algorithmic Inflation of Rent (FAIR) Act
rules.requirement: Makes it an antitrust violation for rental property owners to pay for or use a coordinator's algorithmic software or device that performs a coordinating function, for coordinators to facilitate such agreements, and for anyone to engage in parallel pricing coordination or perform a coordinating function. The Attorney General receives complaints and may adopt rules.
rules.penalty: Violation of the New Jersey Antitrust Act, P.L.1970, c.73 (C.56:9-1 et seq.); sections 6 through 17 of that act remain applicable.
rules.status_basis: Takes effect on the first day of the twelfth month next following the date of enactment (approved July 20, 2026).

coverage.summary: Applies to rental property owners and coordinators for residential dwelling units in the State.
coverage.exemptions_summary: Residential dwelling units exclude inpatient medical care, licensed long-term care, and detention or correctional facilities; governments setting rents through affordability controls are not coordinators.

precedence.text: A municipality shall be prohibited from enacting an ordinance that conflicts with this act.

rules.quoted_span:
